title: mean girls has a glow up and she’s fetch now (this is no shade to the...
transcript: I have a confession I never liked Mean Girls it's just never been my musical but what might have been the biggest surprise of my entire London trip that has now all changed because the Mean Girls in London is not the mean girls of the tour or of Broadway or of the out of town tryout in DC at its core it is almost a new musical like yes it is all the same characters most of the same songs but the way they have structured the story is very different the jokes feel sharper the characters more likable ‘stupid with love’ is now basically a full duet fearless totally gone I honestly cannot tell you all the Changes that have been made because I did not watch the original musical enough to know those changes but it just feels so much better and exactly what I want a mean girls musical to be And without a doubt the cast in London is just phenomenal I really hope we get our own cast recording of Mean Girls in London but I saw this basically only because there was a Friday matinee and when I go back to London I would 100% go again I also legitimately found it moving I teared up multiple times I was not prepared for that and I'm now very curious is this the version that’s on tour now? or is it still different and like what is the Mean Girls high school version book am I now going to go around the country looking for regional productions of Mean Girls so I can track the changes honestly maybe and then the whole thing ended with this delightful little talent show which I also think is new I really don't remember it if it’s not but yeah it was a blast and I'm so glad they decided to keep working on the show even after it was on Broadway anyway mean girls London extremely fetch the I can't believe I just said that
reasoning: Creator who disliked the original Mean Girls was won over by the London revisions, calling it phenomenal, moving, and saying they'd 100% go again. Strong enthusiasm throughout.
